Jordan / team — quick SE notes and 2–3 short talk tracks you can use when briefing Sofia and procurement: 

Talk track: Business ROI (30–60s)
- Example: For online support workflows, customers typically see a 20–35% reduction in agent handle time and a 25–40% reduction in per-conversation inference cost after enabling prefix caching + batching recommendations. For a mid-size Finovate workload this maps to ~$50–120k annualized savings on inference spend (we can refine with your volumes).

Talk track: Security/compliance (30–45s)
- Redwood supports Dedicated and Private deployments with customer-managed KMS and audit logs. SOC 2 summary attached; Neha can provide deeper artifacts.

Talk track: Procurement / Ops (15–30s)
- We offer a POC pricing sheet with a time-limited credit and a mutual action plan to align milestones (SOW, test plan, security checklist, legal review). Pricing_Sheet_Finovate.xlsx will have the POC band.

Technical notes for security/procurement questionnaire:
- SSO: SAML + OIDC; we support SCIM for provisioning.
- Data handling: option for no-persistence KV cache in Private mode; Dedicated provides tenant isolation.
- SLA: Dedicated/Private have SLA options we can include in the SOW.

I'll draft the 3 short talk tracks into a one-page champion brief and send later today.
